name: github-pr-review-triage
description: GitHub PR review triage via gh: fetch unresolved threads and Copilot review summaries, fix, commit, reply, and resolve or acknowledge. Use for Copilot or Bugbot inline feedback.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: GitHub repository as owner/name (for example agents-repo/registry).

inputs.name: dry-run
inputs.description: When true, fetch, triage, fix, and validate only — no commit, push, reply, resolve, or acknowledge. Defaults to false (full automation).

outputs.name: triage-table
outputs.description: Markdown table with kind (thread or review_summary), path, line, author, outcome, and rationale.

outputs.name: handoff-summary
outputs.description: Summary with PR URL, commit SHA, threads resolved count, summaries acknowledged count, and notes.
